answer: Each participant must lock a staking collateral C and evaluate a zero-knowledge verifiable delay VDF(t) that imposes a sequential puzzle of depth t, making parallel forgery infeasible. The contract slashes a fraction σ of C on any deviation, yielding expected utility U = p·R − σ·C with attack success probability p ≈ 0, thus guaranteeing negative expected utility. Rational agents therefore converge to the Nash equilibrium; any attempt to wander the VDF meadow without paying the walnut of time and capital collapses under the temporal barrier.
